purpose: Editorial evidence only; never render this file in the PDF

claims.anchor: một tiến trình có thể thay chương trình đang thực thi mà vẫn giữ định danh tiến trình
claims.support: execve replaces the calling process image and creates no new process
claims.limits: Process attributes may change

claims.anchor: Tiến trình cha nhận PID của con, còn con nhận số 0
claims.support: parent receives child PID and child receives zero
claims.limits: Failure creates no child

claims.anchor: triển khai Linux dùng các trang copy-on-write
claims.support: Linux implements fork with copy-on-write pages
claims.limits: Linux implementation, not universal semantics

claims.anchor: Nếu lỗi, lời gọi trả về `-1`, đặt `errno`
claims.support: success does not return; failure returns -1 and sets errno
claims.limits: C syscall interface

claims.anchor: Nhánh lỗi khiến lời gọi Python ném `OSError`
claims.evidence: API contract and local Ubuntu 24.04 execution, both branches
claims.source_location: Python os.execve; execve(2): RETURN VALUE; wait(2): DESCRIPTION
claims.support: Python raises OSError for exec failure; waitpid returns child termination status
claims.limits: Exit 127 is a convention chosen in the example

claims.anchor: Nó tham chiếu tới một open file description do nhân quản lý
claims.support: descriptor references a system-wide open file description
claims.limits: Distinct descriptors may share the description

claims.anchor: Một namespace có thể cho tiến trình một góc nhìn riêng
claims.support: namespace wraps global resources to present isolated instances
claims.limits: Does not itself prove security isolation

claims.anchor: Tài liệu Linux mô tả quá trình chuyển từ CFS sang EEVDF
claims.support: kernel began transition to EEVDF in 6.6, away from CFS
claims.limits: Scheduler details vary by kernel release

claims.anchor: vùng ánh xạ ẩn danh có thể được tạo trước
claims.support: mapping defines virtual area before regular physical page allocation on write
claims.limits: Not all mappings or access patterns

claims.anchor: Đọc một tệp thường đi qua page cache
claims.support: file reads populate page cache for subsequent reads
claims.limits: Direct I/O and other paths are exceptions

claims.anchor: `fsync` yêu cầu đồng bộ dữ liệu cùng metadata của tệp
claims.support: fsync flushes modified file data and associated metadata
claims.limits: Directory entry may require separate directory fsync

claims.anchor: cgroup là một cơ chế Linux dùng để tổ chức và kiểm soát tài nguyên
claims.source_location: Control Group v2: What is cgroup?
claims.support: cgroup organizes processes hierarchically and distributes resources
claims.limits: Controller behavior depends on configuration

claims.anchor: Từ Python 3.12, `os.fork()` có thể phát `DeprecationWarning`
claims.support: warns when a multithreaded process is detected
claims.limits: Warning depends on detection

claims.anchor: `nr_throttled` không tăng
claims.support: nr_throttled counts throttled CPU periods
claims.limits: Only measured cgroup and interval

claims.anchor: không có sự kiện `high` hay `oom`
claims.support: high and oom counters record relevant memory events
claims.limits: No exclusion of host or ancestor pressure

claims.anchor: có ít nhất một tác vụ trong nhóm bị nghẽn I/O
claims.support: some total records microseconds with at least one stalled task
claims.limits: Does not attribute to request or device

claims.anchor: nhân phân giải đường dẫn, kiểm tra quyền
claims.support: path components are looked up with directory search permission
claims.limits: Applications may translate kernel errors

claims.anchor: trên thư mục, bit `x` là quyền tìm kiếm/đi qua
claims.support: execute bit on directory grants search permission
claims.limits: ACL and further policies may apply

claims.anchor: Một hard link khác có thể trỏ tới cùng inode
claims.source_location: inode(7): Inode number and Link count
claims.support: hard links are names referring to one inode
claims.limits: Cannot normally cross filesystems

claims.anchor: `Type=exec` khiến thao tác khởi động chờ tới khi thực thi được binary
claims.support: start waits until service binary has executed and reports setup failures
claims.limits: Does not signal application readiness

claims.anchor: `Restart=on-failure` yêu cầu thử chạy lại
claims.support: on-failure restarts after nonzero exit or abnormal termination
claims.limits: Rate limiting and persistent failures remain

claims.anchor: `User=atlas` và `Group=atlas`
claims.support: these options set Unix credentials for executed processes
claims.limits: Account must exist on target host

claims.anchor: `After=network.target` trong unit chỉ đặt thứ tự
claims.support: ordering and requirement dependencies are independent; After does not pull in unit
claims.limits: Ordering applies when both jobs are scheduled

claims.anchor: `network.target` là mốc thụ động
claims.support: network.target is passive and does not ensure completed IP configuration; online target is pulled by consumers
claims.limits: Online readiness depends on network manager, not remote service

claims.anchor: địa chỉ dành cho tài liệu
claims.support: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/24 are documentation blocks
claims.limits: Illustrative values, not reachable endpoints

claims.anchor: prefix cụ thể hơn thắng prefix ngắn hơn
claims.support: forwarding chooses longest matching prefix
claims.limits: Linux policy routing can select a different table first

claims.anchor: ARP của IPv4 hỏi
claims.source_location: RFC 826 packet reception and request; ip-neighbour(8) DESCRIPTION
claims.support: ARP resolves protocol address to link address on local link; Linux neighbour table stores bindings
claims.limits: IPv6 uses different neighbor discovery

claims.anchor: `ip route get 198.51.100.20` hữu ích
claims.support: get resolves route for a specified destination rather than only listing route entries
claims.limits: Local lookup is not proof of successful forwarding

claims.anchor: client gửi SYN từ một cổng nguồn tạm thời
claims.support: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK synchronize two TCP endpoints
claims.limits: Simultaneous open and extensions also exist

claims.anchor: `ss -ltn` trên đúng network namespace
claims.evidence: Linux socket inspection and bind semantics
claims.support: ss lists listening TCP sockets; loopback-bound IPv4 socket is local to its namespace
claims.limits: Socket state alone is not application health

claims.anchor: `connect` báo `ECONNREFUSED`
claims.support: ECONNREFUSED when no one is listening; ETIMEDOUT when connection attempt times out
claims.limits: Firewall behavior may produce similar client symptoms

claims.anchor: Cửa sổ nhận giới hạn lượng dữ liệu
claims.support: receiver window and congestion window are distinct limits; minimum governs outstanding data
claims.limits: Specific Linux congestion algorithm may differ

claims.anchor: gateway trong ví dụ thực hiện NAPT
claims.support: NAPT translates private source address and TCP/UDP port and maintains binding for reverse translation
claims.limits: Example ports are synthetic and mapping policy varies

claims.anchor: theo dõi kết nối của netfilter
claims.source_location: nf_conntrack sysctl: count, max, TCP timeouts
claims.support: Linux netfilter maintains flow entries for original and reply directions
claims.limits: A flow entry is not proof of application acceptance

claims.anchor: `ss -ltn` chỉ thấy `127.0.0.1:443`
claims.evidence: inference from Linux bind and connect contracts
claims.support: listener bound to loopback does not accept packets addressed to the external IPv4 address
claims.limits: RST source and firewall policy require separate check

claims.anchor: Mỗi SYN chiếm một vị trí trong không gian số thứ tự
claims.source_location: RFC 9293 sections 3.4 and 3.5, SEG.LEN and three-way handshake
claims.support: SYN occupies one sequence number; cumulative ACK X acknowledges all octets before X; retransmitted data retain sequence numbers
claims.limits: Trace uses synthetic initial sequence numbers and omits options, wraparound and reordering

claims.anchor: Bộ phân giải có thể dùng thông tin cục bộ hoặc hỏi recursive resolver
claims.support: stub resolvers can ask recursive name servers, which use cache or authoritative data
claims.limits: Host and application lookup policies vary

claims.anchor: Mỗi bản ghi có TTL giới hạn thời gian lưu ở cache DNS
claims.support: TTL bounds RR caching lifetime
claims.limits: Application caches and retained connections can behave separately

claims.anchor: Kết quả không tồn tại tên (NXDOMAIN) cũng có thể được cache
claims.support: negative DNS answers can be cached with bounded lifetime
claims.limits: NXDOMAIN differs from transport failure; resolver policy matters

claims.anchor: client bắt đầu TLS bằng ClientHello
claims.support: ClientHello begins TLS negotiation; SNI can guide server certificate selection
claims.limits: SNI is not certificate verification and some handshakes use other authentication modes

claims.anchor: Client phải kiểm tra chuỗi tin cậy, thời hạn và danh tính
claims.source_location: RFC 8446 section 4.4.2; RFC 9525 sections 6 and 7; RFC 9110 section 4.3.4
claims.support: authenticated TLS service identity requires validating certificate chain and matching presented identity to reference name
claims.limits: Exact trust policy and revocation behavior depend on client

claims.anchor: TLS tới proxy không tự mã hóa đoạn proxy–upstream
claims.evidence: architectural inference from intermediary and TLS endpoint definitions
claims.support: proxy is a separate communication endpoint and any upstream leg needs its own transport protection
claims.limits: Specific deployments may use end-to-end tunneling instead

claims.anchor: HTTP/2 có thể ghép nhiều luồng trên một kết nối TCP
claims.source_location: RFC 9113 sections 2 and 5; RFC 9114 sections 1 and 2
claims.support: HTTP/2 multiplexes streams on a connection commonly over TCP; HTTP/3 maps HTTP semantics to QUIC
claims.limits: The chapter's main trace is HTTP/1.1 over TLS and TCP

claims.anchor: Reverse proxy nhận request ở phía client
claims.support: intermediaries receive a request and forward or answer it according to routing and configuration
claims.limits: Proxy route selection is implementation-specific

claims.anchor: nó có thể tạo `504 Gateway Timeout`
claims.support: 502 denotes invalid upstream response; 504 denotes missing timely upstream response for a gateway
claims.limits: Status alone does not identify which component generated it or root cause

claims.anchor: Cache HTTP lưu phản hồi đủ điều kiện
claims.support: HTTP caches store eligible responses and use freshness or validation rules
claims.limits: Application-level caches may have separate behavior; sensitive responses need explicit policy

claims.anchor: Giả sử upstream ghi nhận request và kẹt ở truy vấn dữ liệu
claims.evidence: hypothetical diagnosis constrained by gateway timeout semantics
claims.support: gateway timeout is consistent with a delayed upstream response
claims.limits: The scenario is synthetic, not evidence of a real deployment

claims.anchor: Trace dưới đây là dữ liệu giả định
claims.evidence: schematic HTTP/1.1 exchange reviewed against message framing and proxy semantics
claims.source_location: RFC 9112 sections 2.1, 3 and 6; RFC 9110 sections 3.7, 7.2 and 15.3.1; RFC 8446 section 2
claims.support: HTTP/1.1 start-line, Host field, blank-line-delimited fields and Content-Length describe the displayed messages; TLS protects only its endpoints
claims.limits: Example headers, route, payload and status are synthetic; LF display is not wire CRLF

claims.anchor: proxy chủ động đổi `Host` thành `orders.internal.test`
claims.support: an intermediary can generate the request on the next hop and the HTTP/1.1 Host field identifies its target authority
claims.limits: Whether Host is rewritten is a deployment configuration choice

claims.anchor: Một blob chứa nội dung tệp, không chứa tên tệp
claims.source_location: Git Objects: Blob Objects, Tree Objects, Commit Objects
claims.support: blob holds file data, tree associates names and modes with object IDs, commit names root tree and parent IDs
claims.limits: Book diagrams use SHA-1 examples; object format can vary

claims.anchor: Git cũng hỗ trợ kho SHA-256
claims.support: Git init accepts sha1 and, if enabled, sha256 object formats
claims.limits: SHA-1 remains default in cited release; interoperability may vary

claims.anchor: `git add` chép nội dung hiện tại của đường dẫn vào index
claims.source_location: user-manual: Creating a new commit; index and git add
claims.support: git add records current file content into index and later worktree edits need staging again
claims.limits: Partial staging can select only some hunks

claims.anchor: `HEAD` thường là tham chiếu tượng trưng
claims.support: HEAD commonly refers symbolically to the current branch and commit advances that branch ref
claims.limits: Detached HEAD is an exception

claims.anchor: index có thể giữ ba stage cho tệp xung đột
claims.evidence: Git merge conflict contract and tagged upstream source documentation
claims.source_location: git-merge(1): TRUE MERGE and HOW CONFLICTS ARE PRESENTED; git-merge.adoc: TRUE MERGE
claims.support: on conflict HEAD stays, MERGE_HEAD records other side, index stages 1/2/3 contain base/ours/theirs
claims.limits: Not every conflict has all three stages; add/delete can omit a side

claims.anchor: chỉ sau đó tạo merge commit `M` với hai cha
claims.support: diverged histories require a new two-parent commit while fast-forward can move a ref without new commit
claims.limits: A user may choose other strategies or squash; model assumes ordinary merge

claims.anchor: tạo commit mới `C′` có cha là `D`
claims.support: rebase reapplies commits onto new base and writes new commits, changing branch history
claims.limits: Empty or duplicate commits can be dropped under options; example has one nonempty conflict

claims.anchor: `git revert -m 1 M` xem `D` là mainline
claims.support: reverting a merge needs a selected parent and records new commit reversing change relative to it
claims.limits: Reverting a merge affects subsequent remerge semantics

claims.anchor: `--soft`, mặc định `--mixed`, và `--hard`
claims.support: reset moves current branch tip and updates index/worktree according to mode; hard can discard tracked local changes
claims.limits: Pathspec form of reset updates index without moving HEAD

claims.anchor: Bash đọc cú pháp trước
claims.support: Shell parses operators and quoting before the documented expansions
claims.limits: Expansion details depend on context and quoting

claims.anchor: `tar -C "$src"` đưa đúng một đường dẫn
claims.source_location: Double Quotes; Word Splitting; Filename Expansion
claims.support: Double quotes inhibit word splitting and filename expansion of parameter expansion
claims.limits: Assumes ordinary scalar src and no later eval

claims.anchor: Phép gán đơn giản `src=$1` không tách word
claims.support: Assignment RHS undergoes expansion without word splitting or pathname expansion
claims.limits: Later unquoted use can still split

claims.anchor: cả pipeline có status 0
claims.support: Without pipefail pipeline status is last command status
claims.limits: Assumes tee is last and exits zero

claims.anchor: Mảng `PIPESTATUS` trong Bash giữ status từng phần
claims.support: PIPESTATUS contains last foreground pipeline command statuses
claims.limits: Subsequent simple command changes recorded status

claims.anchor: GNU `tar` phân biệt 0 thành công, 1 khi file thay đổi trong lúc tạo kho và 2 cho lỗi nghiêm trọng
claims.source_location: General Synopsis of tar: exit status
claims.support: Tar manual defines 0, 1 for changed input during create/append/update, and 2 fatal
claims.limits: Other options give status 1 different meaning; child status can propagate

claims.anchor: Nó bỏ qua lỗi ở phép thử `if`/`while`
claims.support: errexit excluded in if/while tests, nonfinal lists and pipeline contexts
claims.limits: Function behavior also depends on call context

claims.anchor: Bash không ở POSIX mode thường tắt `errexit`
claims.source_location: Command Substitution; The Shopt Builtin: inherit_errexit
claims.support: Subshell for command substitution clears errexit unless POSIX mode or inherit_errexit
claims.limits: Applies to Bash, not arbitrary POSIX shells

claims.anchor: `SIGKILL` không bắt được
claims.support: Bash traps execute on catchable signals or EXIT; SIGKILL cannot be trapped
claims.limits: Foreground command may delay trap handling

claims.anchor: `tar` không thể đổi sang nguồn và thoát 2
claims.evidence: local experiment and documented fatal-error code
claims.source_location: General Synopsis of tar: exit status
claims.support: Missing input directory is fatal in tested GNU tar 1.35; observed exit 2
claims.limits: Observed on Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL; diagnostics may vary

claims.anchor: `mktemp` tạo file riêng trong thư mục đích
claims.evidence: tagged upstream utility contract and local experiment
claims.support: mktemp securely creates named temporary file from template; local run confirmed same destination directory
claims.limits: Requires trusted destination path and suitable filesystem

claims.anchor: GNU `ln` mặc định thất bại
claims.evidence: tagged upstream utility contract and local experiment
claims.support: ln makes hard link by default and normally does not replace an existing target
claims.limits: Same-filesystem requirement; hostile directory race not solved

claims.anchor: `tar -tf` kiểm tra archive đọc được về mặt cấu trúc
claims.support: tar -t lists archive members without extracting payload
claims.limits: Not a restore or integrity guarantee

claims.anchor: Hai API này mặc định không gọi shell
claims.source_location: Python subprocess Frequently Used Arguments; Go os/exec Overview
claims.support: Sequence argv is passed without implicit shell parsing in both APIs
claims.limits: Child program may parse arguments or spawn shell itself

claims.anchor: Python `env=None` và Go `Cmd.Env=nil` cho con kế thừa môi trường hiện tại
claims.support: Default subprocess environment is inherited
claims.limits: Inheritance may expose configuration or secrets

claims.anchor: `subprocess.run` với `check=False` trả `CompletedProcess`
claims.support: run returns CompletedProcess on nonzero exit when check is false
claims.limits: Spawn and timeout use exceptions instead

claims.anchor: API kết thúc và chờ tiến trình con trực tiếp rồi ném `TimeoutExpired`
claims.support: on timeout child is killed and waited for before TimeoutExpired
claims.limits: Initial process creation may not be interruptible immediately

claims.anchor: `Run` trả `nil` khi lệnh chạy và kết thúc thành công
claims.support: Run returns nil on successful zero exit; nonzero reports error
claims.limits: Start and I/O failures can have other error types

claims.anchor: `CommandContext` mặc định yêu cầu kill tiến trình con trực tiếp
claims.support: CommandContext default Cancel kills Process when context completes
claims.limits: Not an automatic process-tree or remote-work rollback

claims.anchor: cả hai bản điều phối đều cho cùng bốn loại kết quả
claims.evidence: local controlled execution on Python 3.12.8 and Go 1.27.1
claims.support: Run matrix checks success, false success, nonzero exit and timeout
claims.limits: Demo-only; exact timing may differ on slower hosts

claims.anchor: `os.Exit` trong Go còn bỏ qua các `defer`
claims.support: os.Exit terminates immediately without running deferred functions
claims.limits: Applies to defer in terminating process

claims.anchor: virtual environment là thứ tái tạo được
claims.support: virtual environments isolate packages and are disposable, not portable artifacts
claims.limits: Exact dependency locking requires packaging tool workflow

claims.anchor: module ghi yêu cầu ở `go.mod`, checksum dependency được quản lý ở `go.sum`
claims.source_location: go mod init; go mod tidy; module authentication using go.sum
claims.support: module metadata and downloaded dependency hashes are managed by go command
claims.limits: Standard-library-only demo has no third-party module requirement
